# Brikito

> Brikito is AI construction management software for builders, developers, contractors and PMCs. One app for site chat, daily progress reports (DPR), indents and purchases, materials and inventory, attendance, drawings, meetings and a live project dashboard, with Brik AI on every screen. Site teams work in their own language (including voice notes), and nothing is sent or approved without a person confirming it. Data is hosted in India. Serving India, the UAE, Singapore and Sri Lanka.

Key facts:
- Company: Brikito Private Limited, India
- Website: https://www.brikito.com
- Contact: hey@brikito.com
- Demo: https://www.brikito.com/book-a-demo

## Product
- [Brikito: AI Construction Management Software & App](https://www.brikito.com): AI construction management software for builders and developers in India, UAE and Singapore: site chat, attendance, AI CCTV, reports and live dashboards.
- [Brikito Console: One Place to Run Every Project](https://www.brikito.com/console): Brikito Console is the base platform for every project: site chat, Brik AI, labour, store, documents, subcontractors and approvals in one login.
- [Brik AI: AI Assistant for Construction Teams | Brikito](https://www.brikito.com/brik-ai): Ask about progress, stock, attendance or approvals in plain language. Brik AI answers from live site data and drafts replies, POs and reports for approval.
- [BrikChat: Construction Site Chat App with AI | Brikito](https://www.brikito.com/brikchat): Replace scattered WhatsApp groups with one project chat. BrikChat turns site messages and voice notes into indents, attendance and progress updates.
- [BrikVision: AI CCTV for Construction Sites | Brikito](https://www.brikito.com/brikvision): Add AI to your site CCTV: live headcount, delivery logs, PPE and safety checks, and progress monitoring, 24/7 from anywhere. Fewer site visits.
- [BrikDocs: DPR, BOQ & BBS Report Generator | Brikito](https://www.brikito.com/brikdocs): Generate DPR, DLR, BOQ, BBS, GRN and stock statements in one tap from work your team already logged, with version-controlled construction drawings.
- [How Brikito Works: Site Chat to Live Dashboard](https://www.brikito.com/how-it-works): See five real Brikito workflows: chat to approval, asking Brik AI, CCTV intelligence, drawing takeoff and the recovery dashboard, played out in the app.
- [Brikito Pricing: Construction Management Software Plans](https://www.brikito.com/pricing): Brikito plans for construction teams: Standard with a free trial, Professional for overseeing contractors, and Enterprise. Pricing on request.
- [About Brikito: The Team Building Construction's AI OS](https://www.brikito.com/about): Meet Brikito, the team building the AI operating system for real estate development. Our story, mission, values, pilot results and founder Aashiq Ahamed.
- [Book a Demo of Brikito Construction Software](https://www.brikito.com/book-a-demo): Book a 45-minute Brikito demo. We'll set your team up on one live project and show you site chat, Brik AI and reports running the same day.
- [Free Construction Tools: DPR, Material Tracker | Brikito](https://www.brikito.com/free-tools): Free construction tools from Brikito: a site delay cost calculator, an Excel DPR template with checklist, and a material reconciliation and BOQ tracker.
- [Construction Delay Cost Calculator (₹ per day) | Brikito](https://www.brikito.com/delay-cost-calculator): Free calculator: see what one day of construction delay costs your project in ₹, from overheads, idle labour, equipment hire, interest and LD.
